CommunityApplications.Profile: DockFeed - One Atom feed with the release notes of everything running on your Docker host. DockFeed reads the Docker socket, works out which source repository each container comes from, and merges their release feeds into a single feed you can subscribe to in any reader. When a project doesn't publish releases (or stopped tagging long ago), it follows the commits on the default branch instead. No database, no required API tokens, no config file. Plain Python with a single dependency (feedparser), shipped as a 24 MB scratch image (about 9 MB to download) for amd64, arm64 and armv7.
